create_asset_directory_accessor: create a custom AssetDirectoryAccessor subclass that implements maybe_get_system_dir, maybe_get_user_dir, and get_cache_dir methods
build_standard_asset_directory_accessor: build a StandardAssetDirectoryAccessor instance with an Environment and FileSystem to resolve fairseq2 asset and cache directories
test_maybe_get_system_dir: test the StandardAssetDirectoryAccessor maybe_get_system_dir method to return the FAIRSEQ2_ASSET_DIR or /etc/fairseq2/assets path
test_maybe_get_user_dir: test the StandardAssetDirectoryAccessor maybe_get_user_dir method to return the FAIRSEQ2_USER_ASSET_DIR or XDG_CONFIG_HOME fairseq2 assets path
test_get_cache_dir: test the StandardAssetDirectoryAccessor get_cache_dir method to return the FAIRSEQ2_CACHE_DIR or XDG_CACHE_HOME fairseq2 assets path
